title: Trees
definition: A tree is an acyclic connected graph containing nodes with parent-child relationships.
intuition: Represents hierarchical datasets such as file systems or XML models.
how_it_works: Starts with a single root node. Each node has zero or more children, with exactly one path between any nodes.
when_to_use: To represent nested hierarchies or optimize searching/sorting.
when_not_to_use: When cycles can occur or relations are many-to-many (use Graphs).
complexity: Highly dependent on specific implementation (e.g. BST vs generic trees)
content: A tree is an acyclic connected graph containing nodes with parent-child relationships.
